title: Level 3 (Advanced) - C-6
notes:
West leads the ♥10 against 6NT. South has 11 top tricks (3 spades, 2 hearts, 4 diamonds, and 2 clubs). The spade suit is the only real chance for a twelfth trick.

If spades are 3-3, the contract will make easily. If a defender holds a doubleton ♠J, South must play carefully. If the opening heart lead is won with the ♥K and South cashes the ♠A and a spade from the closed hand, he will be unable to take advantage of a doubleton ♠J. The suit will be blocked and the South hand lacks a side entry.

South must win the opening lead with the ♥A, preserving the ♥K as a later hand entry. South should cash a high spade from the closed hand first as West may have started with all 6 spades. When East follows, the ♠A is cashed next. If the ♠J falls, South can unblock the ♠10 and cross to the ♥K to enjoy a fourth spade trick.
